title: Loupe Preflight Profile
description: Declarative preflight profile (YAML or JSON). Profiles are data, not code — the Qt plugin stays engine-agnostic.

schema_version.description: Profile contract version. Bump only with a coordinated engine + plugin release.

name.description: Human-readable profile name (also referenced by report.profile).

description.description: Optional summary of when to use this profile.

job_types.description: Loupe job categories this profile applies to.

checks.description: Ordered list of checks to run. Unknown ids are ignored or reported by the engine (implementation-defined).

fixups.description: Optional fixups advertised for this profile. Fixups are opt-in; never auto-applied.

severity.description: Finding severity when the check fails. Defaults to error if omitted.

enabled.description: When false, skip this check without removing it from the profile.

amount_pt.description: Bleed or similar length in PDF points (1 pt = 1/72 in). 9 pt ≈ 0.125 in.

required.description: Whether the checked feature must be present (e.g. bleed).

allowed.description: Allow-list for categorical checks (e.g. color-mode or output-intent ICC color spaces).

expected_width_pt.description: Expected trim/page width in points (page-size / trim).

expected_height_pt.description: Expected trim/page height in points (page-size / trim).

raster_confirm.description: When true, run strip-raster confirmation on pages flagged by the fast bounds pass (content-bleed only).

probe_dpi.description: DPI for raster probes (content-bleed, ink-coverage, and color-inventory page inspection).

probe_threshold.description: Pixel channel threshold (0-255) that counts as ink in the raster probe (content-bleed only).

rich_black_k_percent.description: Minimum process-black percentage for rich-black inventory (color-inventory only).

max_ink_pct.description: Maximum total ink coverage percentage (ink-coverage, e.g. 300 for 300% TAC).

min_region_area_pct.description: Minimum over-limit connected-region area as a percentage of the page (ink-coverage).

max_regions_per_page.description: Maximum number of ink-coverage regions reported per page.

analysis_box.description: Page box analyzed by ink-coverage. bleed falls back to trim, crop, then media when those boxes are not explicitly present.

min_effective_width_pt.description: Minimum painted stroke width in points for thin-strokes.

zero_width_epsilon_pt.description: Declared stroke widths at or below this value are hairlines.

confirm.description: When true (default), UI must confirm before applying. Destructive fixups must set confirm: true.

params.description: Optional parameters for automated fixup application (e.g. mode for add-bleed).
